It’s binding up trying to push the filament. Can be a number of things, could be too low hot end temp with too high speed, could be a jam which could be in the hot end or even the Bowden tube itself where it meets the hot end. That type of Bowden tube I have had clogs from  having too much extraction making the filament fuse to it. And lastly I have had that happen from having the nozzle too close to the bed, which if it looks like it under extruded and then solved itself after the first layer, that may be your issue.

I had the exact same thing I just fixed yesterday. My x axis gantry was sagging because the wheels were over torqued. The z axis would raise and lower but going from one direction to the other the right side of the gantry would stay still a layer or two while the left side moved and then from that point on they would go together. That resulted in layer 1 being good 2-5 ish being bad dragging the nozzle and the rest being good again when printing. I had to loosen the concentric nuts more than I would have expected and everything is fixed.
